newsitem.title: USA: Digital Biometrics wins Calif. contract.
newsitem.headline: Digital Biometrics wins Calif. contract.

text.p: Digital Biometrics Inc said Monday that 20 of its fingerprint identification systems will be used by Los Angeles County courthouses to identify defendants for trial, release and incarceration.
The twenty systems, ordered from the County of Los Angeles, will be delivered during the current fiscal quarter.
The total value of the contract is about $1 million.

Digital Biometrics develops, makes and markets biometric identification products and integrates them into data networks. The company's products are marketed to law enforcement and regulatory agencies, and to commercial customers where positive identification is required of employees and customers.
